title: Strongly Connected Tournament
statementMd:
There is a chess tournament in All-Right-City. $*n*$ players were invited to take part in the competition. The tournament is held by the following rules:

1. Initially, each player plays one game with every other player. There are no ties;
2. After that, the organizers build a complete directed graph with players as vertices. For every pair of players there is exactly one directed edge between them: the winner of their game is the startpoint of this edge and the loser is the endpoint;
3. After that, the organizers build a condensation of this graph. The condensation of this graph is an acyclic complete graph, therefore it has the only Hamiltonian path which consists of strongly connected components of initial graph $*A*_{1} → *A*_{2} → ... → *A*_{*k*}$.
4. The players from the first component $*A*_{1}$ are placed on the first ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/00976cc27a4f9568730cd6c0701d14cdfd09f89d.png) places, the players from the component $*A*_{2}$ are placed on the next ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38d5ae6f2c9221ae2553b6a357564bf10d1b7498.png) places, and so on.
5. To determine exact place of each player in a strongly connected component, all the procedures from 1 to 5 are repeated recursively inside each component, i.e. for every $*i* = 1, 2, ..., *k*$ players from the component $*A*_{*i*}$ play games with each other again, and so on;
6. If a component consists of a single player, then he has no more rivals, his place is already determined and the process stops.

The players are enumerated with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. The enumeration was made using results of a previous tournament. It is known that player $*i*$ wins player $*j*$ ($*i* < *j*$) with probability $*p*$.

You need to help to organize the tournament. Find the expected value of total number of games played by all the players.

It can be shown that the answer can be represented as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png), where $*P*$ and $*Q*$ are coprime integers and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/06b2d2761bfb42e45841d5e19be707daeed570d8.png). Print the value of $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ modulo $998244353$.

If you are not familiar with any of the terms above, you can read about them [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strongly_connected_component).

## Input

The first line of input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$) — the number of players.

The second line contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a* < *b* ≤ 100$) — the numerator and the denominator of fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/972ab8e09caa986cba5b2395513cd0c66fbc9cd2.png).

## Output

In the only line print the expected value of total number of games played by all the players. Print the answer using the format above.

## Note

In the first example the expected value is $4$.

In the second example the expected value is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/24bad8c170d1a2f751a54ab5a1ba5ce8bea4e73a.png).

In the third example the expected value is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea8cfdc5095bcc8748d50693206eb4f960a9117a.png).
statementZhMd:
在 All-Right-City 举办了一场国际象棋比赛。共有 $*n*$ 名选手受邀参加比赛。比赛遵循以下规则：

1. 首先，每名选手与其他每名选手各进行一场比赛。比赛没有平局；
2. 随后，组织者以选手为顶点建立一个竞赛图。对于每一对选手，恰有一条连接他们的有向边：获胜者是这条边的起点，失败者是终点；
3. 接下来，组织者对该图进行缩点。该图的缩点图是一个完全有向无环图，因此它只有一条由原图的强连通分量组成的哈密顿路径 $*A*_{1} → *A*_{2} → ... → *A*_{*k*}$。
4. 来自第一个分量 $*A*_{1}$ 的选手被安排在前 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/00976cc27a4f9568730cd6c0701d14cdfd09f89d.png) 个位置，来自分量 $*A*_{2}$ 的选手被安排在接下来的 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/38d5ae6f2c9221ae2553b6a357564bf10d1b7498.png) 个位置，以此类推。
5. 为了确定每个选手在强连通分量中的确切位置，在每个分量内部递归地重复步骤 1 至 5。也就是说，对于每个 $*i* = 1, 2, ..., *k*$，分量 $*A*_{*i*}$ 中的选手再次相互进行比赛，以此类推；
6. 如果一个分量只包含一名选手，那么他不再有其他对手，其名次已经确定，过程结束。

选手的编号为 $1$ 至 $*n*$。编号是根据之前一场比赛的结果确定的。已知对于 $*i*$ < $*j*$，选手 $*i*$ 击败选手 $*j*$ 的概率为 $*p*$。

请你帮助组织这场比赛。求所有选手进行的比赛总场数的期望值。

可以证明，答案可以表示为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png)，其中 $*P*$ 和 $*Q*$ 是互质整数，并且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/06b2d2761bfb42e45841d5e19be707daeed570d8.png)。请输出 $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ 对 $998244353$ 取模后的值。

如果你不熟悉上述术语，可以阅读[这里](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strongly_connected_component)的相关内容。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$），表示选手数量。

第二行包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a* < *b* ≤ 100$），分别表示分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/972ab8e09caa986cba5b2395513cd0c66fbc9cd2.png) 的分子和分母。

## 输出格式

仅一行输出所有选手进行的比赛总场数的期望值。请按照上述格式输出答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，期望值为 $4$。

在第二个样例中，期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/24bad8c170d1a2f751a54ab5a1ba5ce8bea4e73a.png)。

在第三个样例中，期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea8cfdc5095bcc8748d50693206eb4f960a9117a.png)。
